inProgress.title: Accounts and the server list
inProgress.body: A Lowtown account to keep your name online, and a public list of servers to join, on the new accounts site. The launcher links to it under Your account.

inProgress.title: Interiors with people in them
inProgress.body: Houses, flats, shops and workplaces you can walk into, each with the people who live or work there going about their day.

images.alt: Inside a block of flats, a neighbour at an open door
images.caption: A block of flats

inProgress.title: City map and GPS
inProgress.body: A full-screen map of Calder Bay, a radar in the corner, and a waypoint the GPS draws a route to.

inProgress.title: Night in the city
inProgress.body: Lit windows and headlights that light the road. The city has three times of day for now.

releases.label: 0.1.0 (beta)
releases.title: First build
releases.summary: Calder Bay, a harbour city with traffic, people, police, jobs and shops, alone or online with friends.

entries.title: Calder Bay.
entries.text: Downtown towers, shops and offices, houses, industry, docks and parks on a nine-by-nine grid of streets, with hills and the sea round it.

images.alt: Calder Bay's harbour and docks on a clear morning
images.caption: The harbour

entries.title: Traffic and cars.
entries.text: Traffic keeps its lanes and stops at the lights. Take any car, parked or pulled from its driver.

images.alt: A white sports car driving down a city street
images.caption: On the road

entries.title: People on the street.
entries.text: Voiced people who walk the pavements, talk to each other and run from gunfire, with a few outrageous characters among them.

entries.title: Jobs, cash and shops.
entries.text: Courier runs, repossessions and gang bosses at the yellow markers; spend the money at the gun shop and the paint shop.

entries.title: Wanted level.
entries.text: One to five stars. The police arrest at one and shoot from two; stay out of sight and the stars come down.

entries.title: Online.
entries.text: Host the city for friends or join theirs; the host runs the city.
